not_judged: a scanned slave's PDO mapping is read from the drive when the bus starts and judged then, with the same rules as a declared one; the live slave identity (SII serial, 0x1009, 0x100A, scanned PDO mapping digest), fault-reset pacing against the period and the DC sync0 rules are judged at startup too; the drive accepts or refuses its startup SDOs (startup_sdo, and the 0x1C32:02 written for dc.write_cycle_time) at PREOP->SAFEOP; a SYNC0 cycle it cannot run is refused at PREOP->SAFEOP, or later as a sync error that drops the slave out of OP after it reached OP (documented drive behaviour, not a guarantee for every drive); both show in the kernel log
